message.reasoning:
The user says: "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker on Windows using docker start. But docker start is used to start containers, not the Docker daemon. To start Docker service, you need to start the Docker Desktop or the Docker Engine service. On Windows, you can use "net start com.docker.service" or "Start-Service Docker" in PowerShell. Or if using Docker Desktop, you can launch the Docker Desktop application. The user might want to start Docker engine via command line. So we can provide a command: "net start com.docker.service" or "Start-Service Docker". But the tool expects a Windows command line instruction. We can use "net start com.docker.service". That will start the Docker service. Alternatively, "sc start Docker" or "Start-Service Docker" in PowerShell. Let's propose "net start com.docker.service". We'll call the function.

We need to use the function to execute the command. The function expects a string. We'll pass "net start com.docker.service".
